annotations.title: Create a new TikTok ad account

description: Create a NEW TikTok ad account (advertiser) for the user's business, inside a TikTok Business Center that their own TikTok login administers. This is how someone with no TikTok ad account gets one without leaving Hermoso: when the user wants TikTok ads and has no ad account, offer to create one with this tool, and also when they ask for another one. It runs on the user's OWN TikTok Ads connection and in THEIR company name, never Hermoso's. TWO STEPS, ALWAYS. First call it WITHOUT confirm: that creates nothing and either lists what is still missing (with the industry list when industry is missing) or returns the exact account TikTok would create. Ask the user for every missing field and never guess one: account name, legal company name, industry (a tier-2 id from the list), registeredArea (country of registration, e.g. US) and timezone (e.g. America/New_York). Currency must match the Business Center's and defaults to it. Show the user the summary, then call again with confirm:true. A TikTok ad account CANNOT BE DELETED, only disabled in Business Center. It spends nothing: it has no payment method and no campaigns until the user adds billing in TikTok. Accounts registered in mainland China, Hong Kong, France, Brazil or Mexico need uploaded business documents and are refused unless qualificationId reuses a verified one. If the login has no Business Center yet, create_tiktok_ads_business_center makes one. The new account is read back from TikTok and, when the connection can already reach it, ticked on this brand so every TikTok tool can use it. Free.

bcId.description: from list_tiktok_ads_business_centers; omit when the login administers exactly one

billingAddress.description: required for France, Brazil and Mexico

company.description: legal name of the business that will advertise

confirm.description: REQUIRED true to create; call without it first to see exactly what would be created

currency.description: must match the Business Center currency; defaults to it

industry.description: TikTok tier-2 industry id; call without it to get the list for this Business Center

licenseNo.description: business licence number, for places that require one

name.description: ad account name, up to 100 characters

promotionLink.description: company website; required for an agency Business Center. Pass the brand site when you have it: Hermoso sends it only where TikTok takes it and the reply says when it was not sent

qualificationId.description: reuse a qualification already verified in this Business Center

registeredArea.description: two-letter country of registration, e.g. US

share.description: default true: tick the new account on this brand's TikTok Ads connection

taxId.description: VAT, tax id or ABN depending on the country

name: create_tiktok_ads_account
